tbesh_html:
1) robe
1a) a garment worn over a tunic by men of rank
1b) a long garment worn by David's daughters
1c) a garment of the high priest
1d) (fig.) of attributes

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a robe (i.e. upper and outer garment)
strongs_1890.derivation: from H4603 (מָעַל) in the sense of covering;
